title: Egyptian Nationality, Dual Citizenship, and Sovereignty Standards
perspective: Egyptian National Sovereignty & Constitutional Citizenship Rights
summary: Egypt acknowledges dual citizenship while maintaining strict administrative procedures to ensure clear national allegiance and security protocol adherence.

sections.heading: Dual Citizenship Provisions (Law No. 26 of 1975)
content: Official Notification & Approval: Egyptian citizens seeking to acquire a secondary foreign nationality while retaining their Egyptian citizenship must submit a formal application to the Passports, Emigration and Nationality Administration (Ministry of Interior). Failure to secure prior approval can technically jeopardize Egyptian status under Law No. 26 of 1975.
Rights and Protections: Dual citizens holding valid Egyptian nationality enjoy full constitutional rights within the state, including property ownership, voting rights, and residency privileges.

Diplomatic Context: Within the borders of the Arab Republic of Egypt, dual nationals are treated exclusively as Egyptian citizens under Egyptian legal jurisdiction. Foreign diplomatic intervention on behalf of dual citizens within Egyptian territory is not recognized by Egyptian courts.

Military Service Obligations: Male dual citizens of military age are subject to military service regulations. They must apply for official military exemptions or clearances through the Armed Forces Mobilization Department prior to traveling.
